specification.objective: Warn and block stale compaction preview when the polled store fingerprint changes.

requirements.statement: Expose exact per-target fingerprint in GET /memory using the existing algorithm.
Desktop detects a mismatched source and visibly disables Apply; offers manual regeneration without automatic LLM calls.
Backend remains authoritative under concurrent writes and returns 409 for stale apply.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Expose exact per-target fingerprint in GET /memory using the existing algorithm. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

Desktop detects a mismatched source and visibly disables Apply; offers manual regeneration without automatic LLM calls. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.
Backend remains authoritative under concurrent writes and returns 409 for stale apply. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

invariants.statement: Do not change Hermes files, private method bindings, pending approval execution or compaction native application semantics; retain Magi 1.7.8.

forbidden_states.statement: Unapproved, stale or invalid edits are silently applied; LLM is invoked without explicit user opt-in outside compaction.

inputs.statement: Existing Hermes memory entries and Magi Desktop/backend plugin contracts.

outputs.statement: Documented, tested and reversible UX behavior; no direct native memory file writes.

failure_semantics.statement: On invalid source/remote failure preserve memory, preview and user draft; show actionable error.
